prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / illustration-story.
Produce ONE isolated production UI illustration by extracting and cleanly redrawing exactly the requested mochi character from the supplied FloFlo reference board. The first input image is the AUTHORITATIVE user-approved eight-character reference. If a second input is supplied, it is the already-produced happy icon and sets the shared line quality, canvas occupancy and finish, not the requested character's color or face.
Output ONE character only on a genuine transparent alpha background, square canvas, preferably 1024×1024. No board, grid, text, label, lettering, shadowed card, circle backdrop, frame, border, checkerboard pixels, floor, scenery or watermark. Do not include any UI from the reference.
Character: the purple 开心 mochi: softly rounded squishy body with two small raised arms, two tiny rounded feet at its broad base, happy curved eyes, an open smiling mouth with a tiny pink tongue, pink cheeks, and just three short warm-yellow excitement dashes above. Match the large happy preview in the middle of the reference.
Match the reference EXACTLY in personality: soft hand-drawn organic mochi, simple clean colored outline, tiny expressive face and cheeks, limited very gentle two-tone pastel shading, front-facing flat 2D sticker illustration, no realistic skin, plastic shine, dramatic lighting, 3D depth, grain, wool/fabric, excessive gradients or added detail. The outline must be crisp and continuous for 24px–112px display; face and key prop must remain recognizable at small sizes.
This is the LIGHT-SURFACE variant, designed to sit on #ffffff, #f6f7fc and light ivory cloth. Body remains lavender purple, colored outline moderately dark, facial features dark and high contrast, subtle lighter fill near the center as in the approved reference. Do not add an opaque white border or white disk.
Composition: single centered character, same scale as the other family members, all visible pixels including floating accent comfortably within the central 84–88% of the square, roughly 7–8% clear transparent outer margin, body base near 86% canvas height. Keep the character fully in frame and leave clean truly transparent corners. Keep a simple balanced silhouette, not tiny artwork lost in a huge canvas. No unrelated additions.

Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve.
Create the DARK-SURFACE production variant of the supplied single 开心 mochi PNG. Input is the finished LIGHT version and is the exact edit target.
Preserve the character's identical silhouette, facial expression, pose, limb proportions, tiny prop/accent shapes, element locations, canvas size, transparent margin and pixel placement as closely as possible. This is a color/edge adaptation ONLY, not a new character, redraw, pose, added night theme, or different composition.
Keep the body in the SAME lavender purple family. Gently reduce the chalky pastel brightness to a comfortable softly luminous mid-light pastel for dark surfaces. Preserve clearly dark facial features with strong contrast on the body. Adjust the colored perimeter and add only a very thin softly tinted light separation edge where needed so the silhouette stays crisp against #17151e, #24212d and #322b45. No thick white sticker border, no neon/glow, no black halo, no white halo, no cast shadow. The accent/prop remains readable without being glaring. Maintain the original flat 2D quality and limited soft shading; no realism or extra gradients.
Output exactly ONE same-size square PNG with genuine transparent alpha background. Background stays fully transparent, NOT filled with the dark example color and no checkerboard pixels. No text, label, badge, frame, disk, stars, moon, bedtime accessories, watermark or other additions. The only allowed design changes are small palette and outline adjustments for dark-mode contrast; KEEP THE MOOD AND GEOMETRY IDENTICAL.
